title: Chapter 1 · La Reina Bubbaloo
description: From Bernat stalling to the first fight: the gum minion peeks from behind the car, steps out, pops its bubble, the dogs' eyes turn pink, they attack, and after the win the light turns.

steps.caption: Something pink peeks from behind the parked car

steps.eval: (() => { const b = window.gerard.game.companionPosition; window.gerard.game.setEnvironment('maresme', { x: Math.round(b.x), z: Math.round(b.z) + 1 }); })()

steps.caption: Bernat: «esa cosa rosa que asoma detrás del coche»
The minion oozes out into the street
¡Blub! The dogs' eyes are dark pink now
Bernat: a minion of La Reina Bubbaloo
First fight, straight away: possessed dogs, no escape

steps.eval: (async () => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const b = document.querySelector('#battle'); for (let i = 0; i < 2000 && !b.hidden; i++) { if (!b.querySelector('.battle-result').hidden) return; const attack = b.querySelector('[data-command="attack"] .command-trigger'); const target = b.querySelector('.battle-target[data-side="foes"]:not(:disabled)'); if (target) target.click(); else if (!attack.disabled) attack.click(); await sleep(400); } })()

steps.caption: The minion slips down the manhole; the light starts to turn
«¿Se ha puesto todo… rosa? Y oscuro.»
Passatge Maresme in La Reina Bubbaloo's light
